messages:
leo: Heads-up team: StreamBridge Gateway is GA as of now. This consolidates our streaming API and tool-calling surface into a single lightweight endpoint: POST /v1/streambridge. Full migration guide and notes: https://redwood.internal/docs/streambridge-ga. Please skim if you maintain SDKs or customer-facing docs.

marta: Nice! Any new runtime defaults or models shipped with this?

leo: We shipped mosaic-nano-v1 (ultra-quantized, tuned for tiny memory footprint) and enabled a per-request "cache_hint" field for prefix caching. New orgs get StreamBridge enabled by default; existing orgs have a 10-day opt-in visible in Console. After that we'll schedule staged auto-migrations with canary routing and a short rollback window.

kevin: Ops note: if you need higher-rate canary keys for testing, DM me. There's an automated fallback to mosaic-standard if quality checks fail. Also updated tracing and logs under service path: https://internal-logs/streambridge/1845209876.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Deployment summary: streambridge service rolled out to three regions with canary progression 15% -> 100%. No crash events. Some transient 502s at 18:12 UTC handled by retries.

ashley: Are there breaking changes to request shape or auth?

leo: No auth changes. Request envelope is slightly different: top-level keys are {"model","stream","tools","cache_hint","input"} but we maintain backwards compatibility for 10 days. SDK maintainers should watch for the patch we pushed to the client libs to add a StreamBridge helper.

marta: Billing impact?

leo: Token billing unchanged. Console will surface an estimated per-route cost delta when you toggle to StreamBridge. We also added a small help note about how prefix caching affects cost.

kevin: Example curl to try locally:
```bash
curl -N -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streambridge \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"mosaic-nano-v1","stream":true,"tools":true,"cache_hint":{"prefix":true},"input":"Extract todo items from: ..."}'
```

ashley: I saw a tiny doc mismatch in the migration checklist; opened a PR to clarify rollback steps.

infra-bot: incident-bot: Detected a brief increase in 5xx during canary at 2026-04-05T18:12Z due to a mis-sized connection pool on one replica. Mitigation: increased pool and added backpressure. No customer-facing errors reported.

leo: TL;DR: StreamBridge GA live, mosaic-nano-v1 available, 10-day opt-in for existing orgs then automated staged migrations, canary keys from @kevin, fallback to mosaic-standard, docs + migration runbook at internal link. Ping me or @kevin for questions. :party_parrot:
